legal.title: Subscription terms
legal.intro: These terms apply to monthly online healthcare memberships. They are in addition to our general Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
legal.billing_p: By subscribing you authorize us, through our payment provider, to charge your payment method automatically every month at the then-current plan price until you cancel. Your first payment is taken at sign-up and each renewal on your monthly anniversary.
legal.renewal_p: Your membership renews automatically each month. The renewal date is your subscription anniversary. We do not store your card details — they are held securely by our payment provider.
legal.cancellation_p: You can cancel anytime from your account or the billing portal. Cancellation stops future renewals; your benefits continue until the end of the current paid period. There is no partial-month refund.
legal.refund_p: Outside any statutory cooling-off right, monthly payments are non-refundable after 7 days, and non-refundable for any month in which a consultation credit has been used. We do not issue partial refunds.
legal.price_p: If we change a plan's price, existing members keep their current price for as long as their membership remains active. Any change is communicated in advance as required by law.
legal.tax_p: Prices are shown for {country}. Applicable VAT or local taxes are handled in line with the rules for your country and shown at checkout where they apply.
legal.scope_p: Memberships provide secure online/video consultations only. There are no in-person visits. Care is GP-led; specialist access is offered as a discount, not as an included consultation. The service does not issue prescriptions.
legal.credits_p: Consultation credits are granted each paid month and do not roll over — unused credits expire at the end of the month. Wellness credits are earned on eligible plans, never expire, are redeemable only for eligible home health test kits, and are non-cash and non-transferable. Selected perks unlock after the stated number of paid months.
legal.contact_p: For any billing or membership question, contact our support team.
